subject: Coffee & Tea
title: The Coffee Shop as Coworking Space
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Coffee Shop as Coworking Space usable.

hook.text: Laptops, Wi-Fi, and power outlets turned modern coffee shops into the world's largest coworking network.

buildup.text: Freelancers, remote workers, and students flock to cafés for the ambient noise, social energy, and caffeine access.

discovery.text: Studies show moderate background noise (about 70 dB—typical café level) actually improves creative thinking.

twist.text: Some café owners now limit Wi-Fi hours or ban laptops at peak times—they need table turnover to survive financially.

climax.text: The tension between 'third place' and 'free office' defines the modern café's identity crisis.

punchline.text: A café or an office? The laptop changed the deal forever.

quiz.question: Why does moderate café background noise help creativity?
options: About 70 dB of ambient noise improves creative thinking per research
